evidenceBoundary: Public official documentation reviewed through web search/open only. Anlatan lists NovelAI; NovelAI's links page links docs.novelai.net. No account, inference, live editor, device tests, or source-code inspection. Benefits are hypotheses. Unknown means not established, not absent.

strengths.mechanism: Context Viewer reports composition, insertion stages, tokens and inclusion/exclusion reasons.
strengths.benefitInference: Could help diagnose missing memory before changing prompts.

strengths.mechanism: Edit history preserves alternatives; History chooses a continuation and Retry regenerates.
strengths.benefitInference: Could reduce the cost of exploring alternate continuations.

strengths.mechanism: Key-activated lore can be exported independently.
strengths.benefitInference: Could reuse world material while limiting routine context use.

strengths.mechanism: Scenario exports personalize a premise; story exports retain history.
strengths.benefitInference: Could clarify replay versus continuation when labels explain the distinction.

tradeoffs: Documented chat setup requires Memory, sample dialogue, Phrase Bias and Stop Sequences, including a workaround for incomplete generations.
Hidden lore entries also hide from the Context Viewer until revealed.
Full .story sharing exposes retries and branches; plaintext loses structured state.
Browser-storage clearing and password reset can cause permanent story loss. Downloaded backups matter.
Advanced controls improve author control but increase setup burden.
FAQ context limits conflict with newer model-specific documentation; do not reuse its numbers as universal limits.
unknowns: Live usability, output quality, latency, touch interaction and successful export/import round trips were not tested.
Current-model applicability of the older chat guide is unverified; it references retired Clio.
Character-card interoperability, character marketplace and managed multi-speaker roleplay were not established.
Arbitrary external model endpoints and a self-hosted equivalent of the full app were not established.
Automatic story-to-image integration, per-character conversational voices and migration fidelity to other tools were not established.
reusablePatterns: Expose existing context diagnostics beside memory, with exclusion reasons and optional expert detail.
Separate exact-story continuation from reusable-premise creation; show premise variables before starting.
Offer complete-history versus selected-narrative export with a rejected-reply warning.
Explain backup, storage and recovery consequences beside archive/export actions.
doNotCopy: Manual bias setup as routine character onboarding.
Hidden active lore without an explicit reveal path.
Treating browser-local storage as a backup.
Treating retired-model weight releases as proof of full-service portability.

characterOnboarding.note: Manual character information and dialogue setup; scenario descriptions/placeholders. Standard character-card support unknown.

storyOrganization.note: Story shelves; exact-story navigation and resumption reliability untested.

editRetryBranch.note: Undo/Redo, Retry, branching history, continuation selector and inline generation.

memoryLore.note: Memory, Author's Note and keyed/Always On lore. No unlimited or automatic recall claim established.

promptTransparency.note: Last/Current Context with inclusion reasons and budgets; hidden lore qualifies visibility.

modelConnections.note: NovelAI model selection. Arbitrary external endpoints unknown; catalog distinguishes current and retired models.

advancedControls.note: Context positioning/trimming, Phrase Bias, banned tokens and stop sequences.

groupRoleplay.note: Two-character guide does not establish managed group speakers or group turn control.

imagesVoice.note: Image editor/generation controls; local or streamed TTS and downloads. Automatic scene images and per-character voices unknown.

mobile.note: Mobile browser/PWA and Editor V2 mobile provisions. No device interaction test.

portability.note: .story, .scenario, plaintext, bulk ZIP and lore exports. Cross-tool fidelity untested.

selfHosting.note: Full app/service self-hosting unestablished. Retired-model weight releases do not establish current-service equivalence.
